we found suggestive evidence of association between germline variation within the 5’ region proximal to miRNA genes and risk and survival among breast cancer cases.
germline microRNAs SNPs in pre- miRNA flanking region are associated with breast cancer survival and may be associated with risk among African Americans.

the association of miRNA SNPs in the flanking region of the miRNA gene and the risk of breast cancer.
the role of germline variation within the 5′ flanking region of miRNAs in breast cancer risk and prognosis.
the association of germline miRNAs and breast cancer survival.

these results are preliminary and need further confirmation in larger, well-characterized cohorts.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the 3’ end of pre-miRNA sequences may play a larger role in the regulation of miRNA function than previously thought.
germline miRNA SNPs are not associated with breast cancer in Caucasians, but there is some evidence for associations in African Americans.
germline miRNA variation is a promising avenue for future investigation in cancer.

miRNA SNPs in the flanking region of the pre-miRNA may be associated with risk and survival.
germline microRNAs may play a role in breast cancer risk and/or survival.
